name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
instructions: Adjust the seat so the handles are at upper-chest height and sit with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles and set your shoulder blades back.
Press the handles up and forward until your arms are almost extended.
longevityNotes: Pressing strength keeps daily pushing — doors, shelves, getting up from the floor — easy and safe. Controlled pressing builds the shoulders, chest, and arms that protect you in a fall.
overview: A machine press at an incline that targets the upper chest, shoulders and triceps.
